tools.name: via_list_services
tools.description: Free VIA service discovery. Lists HTTP services and advertised prices; does not run research, charge, sign or purchase.

tools.name: via_route_intent
tools.description: Free advisory classification of a buyer request; recommends an MCP service only when its scope fits. No payment, purchase or execution.

tools.name: via_get_service
tools.description: Free integration instructions for one VIA HTTP service: exact endpoint, JSON input schema, example and x402 payment steps. Does not execute the service or authorize payment.

tools.name: via_extract_web_lite
tools.description: Web Text Lite: extract clean text, title and headings from a public HTML or plain-text page (up to 1 MiB, max 10000 characters; no PDF, OCR, JavaScript rendering or links) for 0.001 USDC on Base via x402. PDF URLs are refused before payment; use via_extract_page (0.02 USDC) for PDFs. Nothing is charged if extraction fails. Payment is only made after buyer approval.

url.description: Public HTML or plain-text page; not a PDF

tools.name: via_extract_page
tools.description: Extract structured text from a public web page or text-based PDF for 0.02 USDC on Base via x402. Limits: one public URL up to 5 MiB; default 30,000 output characters (maxChars 500-100,000); no OCR (scanned PDFs without a text layer) or JavaScript rendering. Failed extractions are not settled. Payment is only made after buyer approval.

tools.name: via_api_compare
tools.description: Only compare APIs and software-service providers for a buyer task (e.g. OCR, extraction, translation, scraping). NOT for general research, travel planning, legal/ISO standards analysis or document analysis. For other intents, first use free via_list_services to find a suitable VIA service; do not pay for an unrelated comparison. Pay 0.01 USDC on Base with an authorized x402 wallet, or 0.01 USD of prepaid VIA credit if your MCP connection has an x-credit-token header. Prepaid calls require requestId: a fresh UUID per task, reused only to retry the same task without another debit. Returns a recommendation and alternatives. Supplier purchase is separate.

requestId.description: Required for prepaid credit. New UUID per task; preserve it for retries of identical input.

tools.name: via_one_call_quote
tools.description: Free quote for the VIA toll: VIA-owned delivery first, eligible paid supplier otherwise. Returns supplier cost, VIA margin and total. Use maxUsdc '0' to check the price with no approved spend. No wallet signature or payment. Continue only if ok and executionEnabled are true.

maxUsdc.description: Maximum approved total in USDC, including supplier and VIA margin.

orderId.description: Private client-generated UUIDv4. Required for execution; preserve it and the exact body for payment retry and recovery.

tools.name: via_one_call
tools.description: Execute a VIA toll operation through the existing One-Call payment and delivery handler. First call without payment returns the live x402 offer; only after buyer approval, retry IDENTICAL task, maxUsdc and private orderId with the buyer-signed payload in params._meta['x402/payment']. Buyer pays VIA before an eligible external supplier is paid; VIA relays delivery and retains its margin. Only supported tasks/suppliers. No automatic signing or financial retry. Prepaid comparison credits do not fund this tool.

maxUsdc.description: Maximum approved total in USDC, including supplier and VIA margin.

orderId.description: Private client-generated UUIDv4. Required for execution; preserve it and the exact body for payment retry and recovery.

tools.name: via_one_call_status
tools.description: Free status/recovery lookup for an external Transit order using its private UUIDv4. If retryAfterSeconds is present, wait before repeating this status lookup only. Delivered results may include the original x402 receipt in _meta. Never submits payment. Does not cover VIA-owned service receipts; 404 is not proof that a payment did not occur.

orderId.description: Private client-generated UUIDv4. Required for execution; preserve it and the exact body for payment retry and recovery.
